issues: Some technical terms are not translated accurately, e.g., 'Model Context Protocol' as 'मॉडल कॉन्टेक्स्ट प्रोटोकॉल' instead of 'मॉडल संदर्भ प्रोटोकॉल' or 'मॉडल संदर्भ प्रोटोकॉल'.
The translation is not always fluent, with some awkward phrasing and word choices.
